architecture.mechanism: Electrospinning a multilayered fibrous web onto catheter surfaces to physically reduce cellular attachment
architecture.intervention: Apply a medical-grade polyurethane multilayered fibrous web via electrospinning to the internal lumen and external surface of the medical shunt valve and its connected catheter segments
architecture.expected_effect: Decreased cell adhesion and debris accumulation within the valve, preventing occlusion and blockage
architecture.falsification_test: Quantify cellular adhesion on the treated valve surface using DAPI staining and ImageJ quantification against a control silicone surface; if cellular counts do not significantly decrease, the mechanism fails

challenge.kill_reason: the mechanism-space distinctness adjudication counts 1 materially distinct mechanism(s) (< 2, mechanism_distinctness/2.0.0) — the run generated nothing worth attacking (Art. LXXXIV, R514)
